chunks: You were not by the western side when We gave the command to Moses, nor were you a witness.

key_terms.بِجَانِبِ الْغَرْبِيِّ: by the western side (of Mount Sinai)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'You were not by the western side' in Surah Yunus?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Yunus (10:75) clarifies that the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) was not a physical eyewitness to the specific moment Allah addressed Moses (AS) at Mount Sinai, thereby distinguishing between direct historical observation and prophetic knowledge granted through revelation. Shia exegetes, such as Al-Tabarsi in *Majma' al-Bayan*, emphasize that this negation of physical presence serves to validate the Prophet's status as a recipient of divine truth rather than a mere observer of past events, reinforcing the continuity of the prophetic message.
